notes.title: Version 1.0 released
notes.notes:
Hello and welcome all soccer fans!

We are very proud of announcing the 1.0 release of Super Button Soccer!

The Early Access period was very fun, full of feedback and great suggestions from our vibrant community. We really feel happy of seeing our game taking shape and creating bonds between players.

Now that the game is released, rest assured that the same level of support and care you found from us will remain - in fact, grow as our community is also receiving new players!

We would also like to give a very warm welcome to all newcomers who are getting into the game now - please feel free to share your thoughts about the game in the forums, schedule matches, and find new friends.

Game on!!!

notes.title: Version 0.21 release notes
notes.notes:
http://superbuttonsoccer.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/06/update-021-PT.png

VERSION 0.21 - RELEASE NOTES

First we would like to thank all of you for your continued support on the discussion forums, reviews, bug reports and chat. This is VERY important for us! We are on bug hunting mode, kicking them to the corner and improving the Super Button Soccer experience.

Here's the complete bug fix log for this version:


 Missing executable error in some Linux distros
 6x1 score in a local multiplayer match
 Inactive players remaining online in the lobby
 White card in the team management screen
 Server unavailable in some Quick Match scenarios
 Trophy not showing in the cup victory screen ːsteamfacepalmː
 Fatal error "Too many threads" 
 Ice stadium card not showing for some users in the level up screen
 Sometimes it wasn't possible to accept bot challenges :)
 Some other minor fixes

notes.title: UPDATE 0.8.2
notes.notes:
http://superbuttonsoccer.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/update082.png

Fala galera, eu sou o @maracatu e estou trazendo para vocês o changelog do update dessa semana, que é a versão 0.8.2! AEEE!

Essa semana criamos um sistema de lobby para saber quem está online no jogo e poder enviar desafios para esses jogadores, mesmo aqueles que não estão na sua lista de amigos! Olha, foi difícil fazer a integração do lobby, mas o resultado ficou bem bacana, esperamos que vocês curtam!
Além do lobby, também incluímos uma nova feature que é o level dos players, SIM MEUS AMIGOS, agora os players possuem level, o que abre uma infinidade de possibilidades nas novas versões, esperamos que curtam!

Dá uma olhada aí na lista completa de correções, melhorias e novas features:


NOVOS RECURSOS
 Novo sistema de lobby (agora é possível ver quem está online)
 Enviar e receber desafios de jogadores no lobby
 Partda Rápida inclusa no lobby para poder já procurar jogadores online
 Opção de jogar contra o bot do desenvolvedor enquanto procura oponente
 Sistema de level adicionado ao jogador
 Barra de XP do jogador adicionada ao menu inicial

MELHORIAS:
 60 FPS no modo multiplayer online!!! Antes caia para 14 ou 15 FPS
 Fluxo na escolha de times
 Opção de escolher o time em partidas local versus
 Revisão de alguns efeitos sonoros dos botões (ainda não são os finais hehe)
 Salvar estatísticas do jogador na nuvem

CORREÇÕES:
 As vezes o jogo travava na tela de formações após o gol 
 No final dos jogos não tinha um aviso para apertar para continuar
 Problema de sincronização dos jogadores quando a partida estava chegando ao fim
 Ímã estava desbalanceado quando se aproximava dele
 Tecla TAB ainda estava aparecendo no tutorial


Não se esqueça de deixar a sua avaliação do jogo ou sugestão! Isso é MUITO IMPORTANTE para as próximas atualizações do Super Button Soccer!
Valeu galera!

notes.title: UPDATE 0.7.1
notes.notes:
http://superbuttonsoccer.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/update_071.png

In this update, we focused in the local multiplayer mode, where now is possible for 2 players play using the same keyboard.
Random names were added to the already existing buttons, paving the way for button customization.
Also, some bugs that escaped from our last update were captured and eliminated, including a nasty one which makes change turns strange.

Check it out the complete changelog:


    Fixed: New icon
    Fixed: Bot controls the game
    Fixed: Menu selection error
    Fixed: Change of turns error
    Fixed: Cup without teams
    Fixed: Cup with wrong avatars
    Fixed: Cup with wrong results
    Fixed: Pixelated fonts
    Fixed: Wrong space in the main menu
    Fixed: Jagged avatars
    Fixed: Some teams with decentralized selection
    Fixed: Change turns after game over
    Fixed: Pressing ESC wont go to the main menu
    Fixed: Bot mimics player choice of team
    Fixed: Clicking outside menu makes it unreachable 
    Fixed: Player avatar is not in cache
    Fixed: Strength indicator is too fast
    Added: New input system, easing the way we add new controls in the future
    Added: Player 2 can use the arrow keys and enter to play on the same keyboard
    Added: Local multiplayer pause
    Added: Buttons with random names
    Added: Savegame is now encrypted
    Added: Internal message system
    Added: Button selection using size variable

notes.title: UPDATE 0.6.3
notes.notes:
http://superbuttonsoccer.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/02/update_063_en.png

It has been a crazy week here at Smyowl.
Soon after the 0.5.3 update, we tested the game a lot in multiplayer, killing a lot of nasty bugs in the process.
Also, enhancements were made in the controls section and we added some features in the game.

New control system
One of the biggest complains we received in the early stages of the game is that the controls were unbalanced.
The player using the gamepad had some issues when playing against a keyboard player.
In this update, we removed the Shift key, which made the precision shot possible to make it more like the gamepad.
We tested and felt that the controls were good but we need feedback from you.

Trading Cards
A LOT of you wanted it. Your wish is our command!
We added plenty of cards with the majority of the Steam features in our game.
This means Achievements, Steam Cloud and Stats.

Training Mode - CUP
With our effort to prepare the game for online ranked matches, we added a cup training mode, to be played with bots.
Now you will train with a variety of "players" and start your preparation to the online mode, which will be available soon!
Play against 16 different bots, each one with a distinct personality.
Keep in mind that the bots are STILL in heavy development, so we will use your feedback to improve them.



Full changelog:



    Fixed: Tournament wont show any team
    Fixed: When quit from tournament, it's not possible to play it again
    Fixed: Wrong localization in the victory screen
    Fixed: Button image wont show in the tournament's end
    Fixed: Avatar image wont load in tournament
    Fixed: Localization error in the gameplay HUD
    Fixed: Multiplayer menu has to be default in mode selection scene
    Fixed: Bot image with bad quality
    Fixed: Tournament screen lacks UI
    Fixed: Stats loss when playing a new game
    Fixed: Bot name wont show in training mode
    Fixed: Avatar image wont load in training mode
    Fixed: Mouse cursor on game
    Fixed: Menu can be accessed from Bot. Applied the Three Laws of Robotics to prevent armaggedom.
    Fixed: Transparent avatar show background buttons
    Fixed: Localization error on game bottom screen
    Fixed: Initial text address only the ones that have gamepad
    Fixed: Button images wont download in some situations
    Fixed: Strength indicator shows when change buttons
    Fixed: Player avatar wont show up in end game
    Fixed: Error in loading game tips
    Fixed: The game closes when ESC is pressed under tournament screen. **FACEPALM**
    Fixed: Returning to the brackets wont show the score during the semi finals
    Fixed: Strength indicator remains on in some situations
    Fixed: Golden goal wont init even after the game reached the end with a draw
    Fixed: The numeric keyboard Enter wont work as a selection button
    Fixed: When a player quits, there is no timeout defined to return to the main menu
    Fixed: The player avatar wont show in training mode
    Fixed: Home and Visitor weren't translated
    Fixed: When training cup is chosen, it can be restarted any time
    Fixed: Crappy fonts
    Fixed: A button from player one is shadowless
    Fixed: Looking for players overlay background is not centralized
    Fixed: Bot always choose the same team from player
    Fixed: Welcome screen must have exit animation
    Fixed: All formations are selected in some situations
    Fixed: After playing with a bot, there is no way to repeat the process using a gamepad
    Fixed: Lack of feedback from magnet button
    Fixed: Strength indicator is too fast
    Fixed: Stats showing up in training mode
    Fixed: Lack of goal animation after the first goal in local multiplayer
    Fixed: Player name error in the end game screen
    Fixed: Translation error in versus mode
    Fixed: Logo animation plays again when changed back to main menu
    Fixed: Team selection screen wont update stats
    Improvement: A white image must be used in the end game hud
    Improvement: Game over modal is too dim
    Improvement: Online cup selection was not clear enough
    Improvement: Online selection mode
    Added: Steam Trading Cards
    Added: Achievements
    Added: Stats
    Added: Save tournament progress on Steam Cloud
    Added: New tournament mode against bots
    Added: 16 new bots

notes.title: UPDATE 0.5.1
notes.notes:
http://superbuttonsoccer.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/02/update051.png

At last!
With the update 0.5.1, we fixed some nasty bugs.
On the other hand, the main focus of this update was to include some features that will prepare the game for even better ones!

As always, join us in our Discord chat to talk with the devs and find other SBS players.


New Teams
Along with the new update, we paved the way to accept custom teams in the future.
Until this is not ready, we added 3 different teams, with new buttons for you to play.
Keep it in mind that this will change in the future and you'll the one who builds your own team.

Training Mode
We added a training mode, for you to play alone and test the new teams.
In this mode, we added two bots that behaves in different ways.
This is in very early development stage, but the bots will evolve or multiply.
In the future, maybe you will write your own bot to play against. Who knows! ;)

Bugs
As always, a lot of bugs were squashed. Many of them were fixed thanks to the community! You rock guys!

Full changelog:

- Fixed: Button animations with Steam avatar images
- Fixed: Looking for players screen now has the correct background
- Fixed: Glitchy screen in the loading scene
- Fixed: Localization errors in the connection screen
- Fixed: Even using the game in English, some strings show up in Portuguese
- Fixed: Wrong size in the splash screen
- Fixed: Cancelling the kick with the kick gauge in zero crashes the game
- Improvement: Analog controls adjustment
- Fixed: Lack of exit animation transitions in the main menu
- Fixed: Tutorial not showing in some cases
- Fixed: Wrong icons when a gamepad was connected
- Fixed: Loading error of the avatars in the looking for player screen
- Fixed: When quit the game, it leads the player to the intro screen
- Improvement: Design adjusts in all interfaces
- Fixed: Training menu in not selected
- Fixed: Fireworks won't complete the animation cycle
- Fixed: Selection error in the options menu
- Fixed: Ball without shadow
- Fixed: Some narrations with bad endings
- Fixed: Team selection screen shows buttons instead of keys
- Fixed: Gamepad was not recognized mid game
- Fixed: In some situations, the change of turns were wrong
- Fixed: After the game, the score shows 0:-1
- Fixed: Main menu exit options selects Versus
- Fixed: If quit mid game, the enemy game hangs
- Fixed: Button selection in multiplayer mode was not working correctly

notes.title: 0.4.2 UPDATE
notes.notes:
Hello hello!

Another update, still focused on squashing bugs but also preparing terrain for the next features, which we will announce soon! :)
Besides gameplay optimizations, we finally added english language support with the possibility of add new languages in the future as well.

Join us in our Discord chat to play with other people and talk to the Devs!


Here is the full changelog:


 Added english language support
 Fixed incorrect ball possession warning in some occasions during multiplayer
 Fixed bug which didn't detect gamepad triggers in online matches
 Fixed gamepad icons showing to keyboard players
 Game optimizations to run more smoothly in some PC's
 Fixed the possibility of a keyboard player control some commands of the opponent gamepad
 Removed avatar hud graphical glitch during change of turns 
 Code refactor in the formations area to allow custom ones to be used
 Improvement in the 2x2 formation to block start goals
 Fixed a bug that, in certain situations blocked the change of buttons and target adjustment when a gamepad was connected
 Align adjustment in players name during gameplay
 Added a quit option during search for players
 Font adjustments
 Adjusted the legibility of the ESC and SPACE icons
 Removed jagged borders in the avatar hud
 Adjusted color and size of the Looking for players screen
 Added timeout when starting a game

notes.title: 0.2.4 UPDATE!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! 
We killed an army of bugs and added some asked features. 

We would like to ask everyone to test this version and let us know if you encounter any bugs.

Ah! Join us in our Discord chat to give sugestions, report bugs or just to talk with other players and the devs!

Features:
Game time now comes from the server
Defining ideal time for the match
Add sound feedback when you enconter an oponent in matchmaking
Message telling who starts first
We removed the teams selection screen. Everyone's now is on the same team to check game balance.

notes.title: 0.2.4 UPDATE!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! 
We killed an army of bugs and added some asked features. 

We would like to ask everyone to test this version and let us know if you encounter any bugs.

Ah! Join us in our Discord chat to give sugestions, report bugs or just to talk with other players and the devs!

Features:
Game time now comes from the server
Defining ideal time for the match
Add sound feedback when you enconter an oponent in matchmaking
Message telling who starts first
We removed the teams selection screen. Everyone's now is on the same team to check game balance.
